# Is a required status check stuck forever?

> Paste your branch protection required status checks and your GitHub Actions workflow YAML to find every required check name no job can ever report again — the reason a pull request sits at 'Expected — Waiting for status to be reported' forever. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
